why_it_happens: The neighbour-transfer loop used to move a piece, score it, and move it back by NEAREST CENTRE, which does not restore the state it undid. The undo is now exact. That gave 533 ligature groups their letter ink back (audit_ligatures `empty` 712 -> 195) — but in three words the buggy undo had been ACCIDENTALLY correcting a body that cluster_line() had merged into the wrong atom in the first place, and the exact undo now hands it back to that wrong atom. The defect is cluster_line's small-atom merge, not the undo; it was simply masked before. Not fixed here because a body-regrouping rule needs its own measured distribution and this change is about diacritics.

words.before: 3 groups — قا | لو | ا (the alef fariqa with its sifr, in its own group)
words.after: 2 groups — قا | لو (the final alef body and the sifr now inside the لو group)
words.verdict: the final alef should be its own <g data-text="ا">

words.before: group الا held the alef body + the hamzat_al_wasl
words.after: group الا holds only the hamzat_al_wasl; its alef body moved into the و group
words.note: the hamzah moving from لين into و in the same word IS right (it is drawn over the و's ink); only the body move is wrong
words.verdict: the alef body belongs in the الا group

words.before: group ذ held one body; group ا held two
words.after: group ذ holds no body at all; group ا holds all three
words.verdict: cluster_line merged all three narrow bodies (alef-hamzah 38.9-41.5, ذ 32.4-37.7, alef 27.7-30.7) into ONE atom, so no regrouping pass can separate them — the cut is what is wrong

words.note: audit_ligatures reports a NEW `empty` group 0 here, but the emitted SVG is byte-for-byte the same before and after: the atom carrying that group is empty, so the emitter writes no <g> for it. The audit builds groups from atoms and counts one the emitter never emits.

class: AUDIT FALSE POSITIVE — verified by reading the atoms, no action
note: All six sit in the group whose data-text NAMES the letter they belong to, and miss the overlap test by 0.4-1.7u because the mark is drawn just past the end of that letter's ink. The text budget refuses to move them, which is the right answer. p187 وَأَذَٰنࣱ (omitted_alif, 1.5u past ذ), p272 دَٰخِرُونَ (1.0u past د), p315 هَٰذَٰنِ (1.9u past هذ), p468 وَذَٰلِكَ (1.2u past ذلك), p535 وِلْدَٰنࣱ (1.3u past لد), p549 بُرَءَٰٓؤُا۟ (maddah, 0.8u past ء). If audit_ligatures ever wants zero here, the fix is in the audit: a mark whose OWN group's data-text names the letter it is a mark of is not misplaced.
